faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need to sign up before buying a course?
faq.a1: Yes. You need a free account before you can purchase a course and start learning.
faq.q2: Can I take the lessons out of order?
faq.a2: No. Each topic unlocks only after you complete the previous topic and pass its quiz — this ensures deep, systematic learning.
faq.q3: What's the difference between a subscription and buying a single course?
faq.a3: A single course gives access to just that one track. A subscription gives access to every course at once, and is far more cost-effective long-term.
faq.a4: You can pay online via Click or Payme. The course unlocks immediately once payment is confirmed.
faq.q5: Where do I watch the video lessons?
faq.a5: All video lessons play directly on our site through the built-in player.

terms.title: Public offer agreement
terms.s1Body: This document sets out the terms for purchasing the online courses provided by SellerCloudX LLC ("IZDOSH Academy", "We"). By purchasing a course, the user ("Student") agrees to these terms.
terms.s2Body: Once payment is confirmed, the Student gets access to the course materials under the chosen plan (Start/Standard/Pro). With a subscription, access covers every active course for the subscription's duration.
terms.s3Body: Course topics unlock sequentially: moving to the next topic requires finishing the current one and, where applicable, passing its quiz.
terms.s4Body: Payment is made via Click or Payme. When choosing installments, the initial payment must be at least 40% of the total. If the payment schedule is missed, course access may be temporarily suspended per the agreement. Payment for a course purchased on an installment plan is never refundable, under any circumstance.
terms.s5Body: Purchased courses are non-refundable by default. A refund is only possible if every assignment the mentor gave was fully completed and no result was achieved — full terms are set out in a separate "Refund policy" document, see the link below. Agreeing via the checkbox at purchase or registration means accepting these terms in full.
terms.s6Body: For any questions, reach us through the "Contact" page.

refund.title: Refund policy
refund.intro: Our terms are honest and transparent — this page states exactly when a refund is and isn't given. By purchasing a course (or submitting an installment request), the Student agrees to these terms.
refund.generalBody: By default, payment for a purchased course is non-refundable. Course access is granted the moment payment is confirmed and materials are made available immediately — so a refund isn't issued simply because you changed your mind.
refund.actionTitle: The one exception: assignments completed, no result
refund.actionBody: If you fully and promptly completed every practical assignment the mentor gave, and still didn't achieve the expected result (for example, sales didn't pick up), we're willing to refund your payment. If the assignments weren't completed, or weren't completed in full, We are not at fault, and no refund is issued under any circumstance.
refund.installmentBody: Payment for a course purchased on an installment plan is never refundable, under any circumstance, regardless of the exception above. By submitting an installment request, the Student separately agrees to this term.
refund.howTitle: How do I request a refund?
refund.howBody: Reach out via the "Contact" page or message the operator/administrator named in your agreement. Refund requests are reviewed within 5 business days, and assignment completion is verified by the mentor.
refund.note: This refund policy is an integral part of the public offer agreement. Agreeing via the checkbox at purchase or registration means accepting these terms in full.
